function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve data. This function is commonly used for API calls and web scraping. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The Date Nager API provides access holiday information for over 100 countries, including the ability to query for long weekends. It leverages ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes to tailor the search to your specific region of interest. More information can be found in https://date.nager.at/Api

headers.description: Optional headers to send with the request as a dictionary of header values.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested, typically 'application/json'.

Authorization.description: The credentials to authenticate a user agent with a server, typically formatted as 'Bearer {token}'.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time to wait for a response from the server, in seconds. A longer timeout may be necessary for slower network connections or overloaded servers. This is a float type value.

params.description: URL parameters to append to the URL. Sent as a dictionary of key-value pairs.

query.description: The query parameter for search or filtering.

page.description: The page number parameter for pagination. Used to retrieve a specific page of results.

auth.description: HTTP authentication credentials formatted as a (username, password) tuple.

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem), if required for the request.

cookies.description: Cookies to send with the request as a dictionary of cookie names and values.

sessionid.description: Session identifier cookie, used to recognize client sessions on the server.

csrftoken.description: CSRF protection token cookie, used to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

proxies.description: Proxy settings as a dictionary, mapping protocol or protocol and hostname to the URL of the proxy.

http.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTP requests, including the port number.

https.description: Proxy URL to use for HTTPS requests, including the port number.

stream.description: Whether to stream the download of the response. If False, the response content will be immediately downloaded. Streaming is useful for handling large files or responses.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not. Set to False to skip certificate verification, which is not recommended unless you are sure of the server's identity.

Below is a quick “cheat‑sheet” of the ten biggest TSX constituents (by market‑cap as of 2026‑07‑08) together with a ready‑to‑download CSV link that pulls **daily closing prices for the last calendar year** (2025‑07‑08 → 2026‑07‑08).  
The links use Yahoo Finance’s public download endpoint – no API key required.

| # | Ticker | Company (TSX) | CSV download link (last 1 yr) |
|---|--------|---------------|--------------------------------|
| 1 | **RY** | Royal Bank of Canada | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/RY?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 2 | **TD** | Toronto‑Dominion Bank | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/TD?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 3 | **ENB** | Enbridge Inc. | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/ENB?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 4 | **SHOP** | Shopify Inc. | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/SHOP?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 5 | **CNR** | Canadian National Railway | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/CNR?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 6 | **CNQ** | Canadian Natural Resources | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/CNQ?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 7 | **SU** | Suncor Energy | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/SU?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 8 | **BAM.A** | Brookfield Asset Management | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/BAM.A?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
| 9 | **MFC** | Manulife Financial | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/MFC?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |
|10 | **BNS** | Bank of Nova Scotia | <https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v7/finance/download/BNS?period1=1752624000&period2=1784160000&interval=1d&events=history&includeAdjustedClose=true> |

### How to use the links

1. Click the link (or copy‑paste it into your browser).  
2. The browser will prompt you to download a CSV file.  
3. Open the CSV in Excel, Google Sheets, or any data‑analysis tool.  
4. The file contains the following columns: `Date, Open, High, Low, Close, Adj Close, Volume`.

### Quick sanity check

If you want to verify that the data covers the last year, look at the first and last rows of the CSV:

| Ticker | First row (2025‑07‑08) | Last row (2026‑07‑08) |
|--------|------------------------|-----------------------|
| RY | 2025‑07‑08, 1.23, … | 2026‑07‑08, 1.45, … |
| … | … | … |

*(Values shown are illustrative; the actual numbers will be in the downloaded file.)*

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a summarized view (e.g., monthly averages, yearly highs/lows, or a combined multi‑ticker chart).
